messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that were observed across Canada in 2023 (based on the federal statutory holidays; provincial variations may add a few more days):

| Holiday | Date(s) in 2023 | Notes |
|---------|-----------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sun) – observed Mon 2 | Long weekend Jan 1–3 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, BC, AB, NB, SK, PEI) | Feb 20 (Mon) | Long weekend Feb 20–21 |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | Long weekend Apr 7–8 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | Long weekend May 22–23 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Sat) – observed Mon 3 | Long weekend Jul 1–3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | Long weekend Sep 4–6 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | Long weekend Oct 9–10 |
| **Remembrance Day** (observed) | Nov 11 (Sat) – observed Mon 13 | Long weekend Nov 11–13 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Long weekend Dec 25–27 |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tue) | Long weekend Dec 25–27 |

**Key take‑away:** In 2023, the main long weekends spanned from the first week of January through the last week of December, with the most extended stretch occurring around Christmas/Boxing Day (Dec 25–27). If you’re planning trips, those are the windows where many Canadians will likely take time off.
